Definition: to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)
BiblicalUsage: The word means to knot or distort, to make crooked what should run straight. The upright walk surely, but the one who perverts his ways will be found out; Israel has made crooked paths for itself; Micah accuses the rulers of perverting all equity; and the perverse in his ways will fall at once.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that perversity is not a mistake, it is a choice to knot the straight path. God sees the knot, and He promises that the one who walks uprightly is safe while the twisted way collapses.
